symptoms: Elliptical to oblong brown spots with greyish-white centers and dark brown borders; yellow halo around spots; spots coalesce causing extensive drying of foliage.
management: Consult local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for registered treatment.
prevention: Practice crop rotation, field hygiene, and use certified seeds.

symptoms: Defoliation during vegetative phase; round holes bored into pods with head inside and body outside; damaged empty pods.
management: Spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha; spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2ml/L.

symptoms: Maggots feed internally on seeds without external pod holes; exit pinholes visible only when adult emerges.
management: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.7ml/L or Quinalphos 25% EC @ 2ml/L at 50% flowering stage.

healthy_signs: Dark green trifoliate leaves with robust branching
Abundant pink active Rhizobium root nodules upon sectioning
Profuse flowering and well-set pods without necrosis or pod-borer entry holes
Erect stem with no vascular wilting
management: Remove and safely destroy severely infected plants to prevent field-wide spread
Spray neem oil (3000 ppm @ 3ml/L) or approved target-specific bio-pesticides
Ensure proper soil aeration through light intercultivation
prevention: Treat seeds with Rhizobium culture and Trichoderma viride prior to sowing
Avoid water stagnation through raised-bed planting or broad-bed furrow system
Practice 2-3 year crop rotation with cereals like sorghum or maize
Install yellow sticky traps and pheromone traps early in the season
